خط الالتقاط. يلفّ صفحتك ويحوّلها إلى نسيج مرة واحدة في كل إطار، ثم يسلّم هذا النسيج لكل عدسة بداخله لتكسره. مطلوب على Skia وعلى الويب حيث لا يستطيع الشيدر قراءة الخلفية بنفسه، وغير ضار على Impeller الذي يستطيع.
مقبض على `LiquidGlassView` واحد: يفرض التقاطاً جديداً للخلفية ويُبلغ عند جاهزيته، للإطارات التي لا يستطيع فيها العارض أن يعرف وحده أن ما خلف الزجاج قد تغيّر.
مقبض على عدسة واحدة: يحرّكها ويغيّر حجمها وأسلوبها من خارج شجرة العناصر التي بنتها.
App-wide cache for the compiled liquid-glass fragment programs.
Package-wide renderer switches.
Defines the refresh rate options for [LiquidGlassView].
مكان العدسة داخل عارضها. النوع الأساس لاستراتيجيتَي التموضع أدناه.
تضع العدسة عند إزاحة صريحة من الزاوية العليا اليسرى للعارض.
تضع العدسة بالمحاذاة — في الوسط أو ملتصقة بحافة — فتتبع العارض عند تغيّر حجمه.
A liquid-glass lens you can place **anywhere in the widget tree**.
Glass **without the shader**: a frosted surface with the lens' own rim light, drawn from plain canvas geometry.
Where a painted rim gets its colour — and what that costs.

The **look** of a liquid-glass surface, bundled into one reusable descriptor: its [shape] (corners + border), its [appearance] (fill tint, blur, saturation, inner transparency) and its [refraction] (how it bends the content behind it).
The geometry, border and lighting of a liquid-glass lens.
**Material** group: the lens's appearance — tint, blur, saturation and inner transparency (everything visual that isn't optical refraction).
**Refraction** group: how the glass bends light — the optical distortion of the content behind the lens.
ضبابية الخلفية خلف الزجاج، على هيئة زوج من قيم sigma. محوران منفصلان كي يستطيع الشريط أن يضبّب بقوة عبر ضلعه القصير وبالكاد على طوله.
The contact shadow of a glass pill: a soft dark band that hugs the rim and pools underneath, so the glass reads as sitting *in* the surface rather than floating flat on it.
The corner curve of a [LiquidGlassShape].
How a lens is **clipped** to its outline.
Defines how lighting is calculated along the liquid glass border.
Defines the rendering style for the liquid glass border.
Classic sweep gradient border.
Apple-style optical border.
For backward compatibility — the enum is still used internally by the shader dispatch logic.
Base type for a liquid-glass refraction calculation and its controls.
The package's original nonlinear distortion calculation.
A physical refraction approximation based on Snell's law.
Determines which geometry directs light through the liquid glass surface.
Draws every `LiquidGlassLens` beneath it as **one** sheet of glass.
Draws every `LiquidGlassLens` beneath it from **one** read of the backdrop.

Draws two to eight descendant `LiquidGlassLens` widgets with **one shader** — one backdrop read and one material for all of them — and, above `smoothness: 0`, blends their silhouettes into one liquid surface.
How a glass surface **answers a finger**, bundled as one descriptor.
Touch-driven **soft-body deformation** for a lens that does not move.
One resolved frame of [LiquidGlassFlex] deformation.
The knobs of [LiquidGlassFlex] that are set once and then left alone — grouped so they stay out of the main constructor.
How much of the stretched-outline behaviour is active.

The sliding thumb's whole thumb effect as one isolated, reusable component: the two-state morph (contracted ↔ expanded glass), the acceleration squash / stretch ([LiquidGlassLensMotion]), and the driven-lens rendering — so the same living glass pill can ride a slider track, a bottom nav bar, or anything else that moves it.
The running simulation behind [LiquidGlassLensMotionSpec].
The acceleration→deformation physics of a moving glass body, extracted from the stretch slider's thumb into a component-agnostic class.
Wraps [child] so a pan gesture drags it, with the same smoothness as the built-in drag — and without baking drag into the lens itself.
iOS-style adaptivity: the glass tint **and** the lens content switch between two palettes depending on whether the background behind the lens is dark or light.
Tuning for the background sampling that powers [LiquidGlassAdaptivity] inside a `LiquidGlassView`.
An invisible region that **drives adaptivity for everything inside it** — the group form of `LiquidGlassStyle.adaptivity`, with zero wiring.
What a [LiquidGlassAdaptiveArea] exposes to its descendants: the [adaptivity] to inherit and the [link] carrying the area's verdict.

Makes **bare content adaptive** — icons and text that sit directly on the page with no glass behind them (a hero title over a photo, a floating caption) follow the animated adaptive content color exactly like a lens child would.
Shares one adaptivity verdict between widgets that can't sit in the same subtree, so they flip **together** — same state, same instant.
Runtime pause/resume switch for [LiquidGlassAdaptivity] — attach one via [LiquidGlassAdaptivity.controller] and every widget carrying that config obeys it.
Where a verdict comes from when there is nothing better: no `permanentBrightness`, no link to follow, no enclosing area, no sampler, and no `initialBrightness` guess.
Which system bars an adaptive widget's verdict also drives — the glass and the OS chrome flip together, like Android's own gesture pill.

iOS-style scroll edge treatment: a **fading dim band** pinned over a scrollable's edge so floating glass elements (nav pills, app bars) stay legible over whatever scrolls beneath — the "subtle dimming" variant of Apple's scroll edge effect, without any blur of its own.
Which screen edge a [LiquidGlassScrollEdge] hugs.
How a [LiquidGlassScrollEdge] layers its backdrop blur.
A pill-shaped action button rendered as liquid glass.
A floating action button (FAB) rendered as liquid glass.
Alias for [LiquidGlassFab].
A generic dialog container rendered as a liquid glass surface.
An alert dialog rendered with a liquid glass surface.
Displays a liquid glass dialog over the current route.
A sheet of liquid glass — the panel [showLiquidGlassSheet] presents, and an ordinary widget you can place yourself.
Presents [builder]'s content on a [LiquidGlassSheet].
How a [LiquidGlassSheet] meets the bottom of the screen.
مزلاج زجاجي يرتفع مقبضه ليصير عدسة تحت إصبعك، ويتمدّد بمقدار سرعة دفعك له، ثم يستقر عائداً إلى مساره. يملك زجاجه بنفسه فلا يحتاج عدسة حوله.
Geometry of a [LiquidGlassSlider]: the track, the two thumb sizes it morphs between, and the end icons.
A drop-in liquid-glass switch, in the sliding style where the thumb is picked up and carried rather than snapped between two ends.
Sizing for [LiquidGlassSwitch] — the track behind the thumb and the two sizes the thumb itself morphs between.
A sheet of liquid glass that MORPHS to fit whatever you put in it.
How a [LiquidGlassMorph] travels between shapes.
The knobs of [LiquidGlassMorphMotion] that are set once and then left alone — grouped so they stay out of the way without being out of reach.
A `Scaffold`-style layout for liquid-glass UIs.
The scaffold's adaptivity: the palettes its glass chrome wears, and the edge strips that drive the **system bars**.
A floating, drop-in liquid-glass **app bar** — a translucent bar with an optional [leading] widget, a [title], and trailing [actions], all refracting the content behind it.
A floating, drop-in liquid-glass bottom navigation bar.
Description of a single tab in [LiquidGlassTabBar].
Companion floating action button rendered as its own liquid-glass pill, mirroring the pattern of pairing a tab bar with a separate, side-floating action (often Search).
**Item** group for [LiquidGlassTabBar]: how each tab's icon and label render.

**Selection pill** group for [LiquidGlassTabBar]: everything about the highlight behind the active tab — its look, whether it slides, and whether/where it upgrades to the glass-refracting morphing pill.
**Magnifier pill** group for [LiquidGlassTabPillStyle]: the invisible second pill mounted **under** the moving glass pill on the Impeller path.
Which renderer(s) get the full iOS-26 **glass-refracting** morphing pill (the dual-pipeline animated bar).
Everything a [LiquidGlassGlyphBuilder] needs to draw one glyph in the state its host is currently rendering it.
Builds custom glyph content — an SVG, a PNG, a `CustomPaint`, a badge — anywhere the package would otherwise draw an [Icon].
Everything a [LiquidGlassLabelBuilder] needs to draw one tab label in the state its host is currently rendering it.
Builds custom label content — a different font, rich text, a badge row — anywhere the package would otherwise draw the item's label as a plain [Text].

Wraps [child] in the clip that matches [shape]'s outline, honoring its [LiquidGlassShape.clipQuality]: a circular `ClipRRect`, a shader-matched squircle `ClipPath`, or an Apple capsule-style continuous `ClipPath`.
The corner radius used to **clip** a lens to its outline.
The shader corner-style selector (`u_cornerStyle`), derived from [LiquidGlassShape.cornerStyle]:
Whether the shape uses a rounded clip for its blur-backdrop and child clips.
Tessellation density for a corner of on-screen [reach] — shared by both curved corner styles.
The continuous-curvature (squircle) outline — the SAME L^n superellipse the shader draws.
The capsule-style continuous rounded-rectangle outline: each corner is a p-norm ball whose box is stretched along whichever edge has room, with an exponent that rises with that same room.
